lines.s: Shall we meet in the café before the film?
lines.zh: 看電影前我們在咖啡店見好嗎？
lines.en: Shall we meet in the café before the film?

lines.s: It'll be really crowded on a Saturday. Let's just meet outside the cinema at seven. The bus station is too far for you.
lines.zh: 星期六那裡會很擠。我們七點直接在電影院外面見吧，公車站對你來說太遠了。
lines.en: It'll be really crowded on a Saturday. Let's just meet outside the cinema at seven. The bus station is too far for you.

q.s: Where will they meet?
q.en: Where will they meet?

explain.zh: 咖啡店太擠、公車站太遠，「七點直接在電影院外面見」。
explain.en: Outside the cinema at seven.

lines.s: My torch isn't working.
lines.zh: 我的手電筒壞了。
lines.en: My torch isn't working.

lines.s: Have you changed the batteries?
lines.zh: 你換電池了嗎？
lines.en: Have you changed the batteries?

lines.s: Yes, yesterday. I think it's the bulb. I'll get a new one tomorrow.
lines.zh: 換了，昨天換的。我想是燈泡的問題，明天去買個新的。
lines.en: Yes, yesterday. I think it's the bulb. I'll get a new one tomorrow.

q.s: What does the man need to buy?
q.en: What does the man need to buy?

explain.zh: 電池昨天換過了，「我想是燈泡的問題，明天去買個新的」。
explain.en: The batteries are new; he needs a bulb.

lines.s: Are you still playing volleyball?
lines.zh: 你還在打排球嗎？
lines.en: Are you still playing volleyball?

lines.s: No, I stopped last year. I've just joined a climbing club instead. My brother wants me to try tennis, but I'm not sure.
lines.zh: 沒有，去年就不打了。我剛加入攀岩社。我哥想要我試試網球，但我還不確定。
lines.en: No, I stopped last year. I've just joined a climbing club instead. My brother wants me to try tennis, but I'm not sure.

q.s: Which sport has the girl just started?
q.zh: 女孩剛開始哪一種運動？
q.en: Which sport has the girl just started?

explain.zh: 排球已經不打了，網球還不確定，「剛加入攀岩社」。
explain.en: She has just joined a climbing club.

lines.s: Was your house all right in the storm?
lines.zh: 暴風雨的時候你家還好嗎？
lines.en: Was your house all right in the storm?

lines.s: The roof was fine, luckily, and so were the windows. But part of the fence blew down.
lines.zh: 屋頂還好，窗戶也沒事。可是籬笆有一段被吹倒了。
lines.en: The roof was fine, luckily, and so were the windows. But part of the fence blew down.

q.s: What was damaged in the storm?
q.en: What was damaged in the storm?

explain.zh: 屋頂和窗戶都沒事，「籬笆有一段被吹倒了」。
explain.en: Part of the fence blew down.

lines.s: Have you got everything? We're leaving now.
lines.zh: 東西都帶了嗎？我們要出發了。
lines.en: Have you got everything? We're leaving now.

lines.s: Wait — I've got my phone and my wallet, but I've forgotten my keys. I'll just run back and get them.
lines.zh: 等一下，手機和錢包都帶了，可是忘了鑰匙。我跑回去拿。
lines.en: Wait — I've got my phone and my wallet, but I've forgotten my keys. I'll just run back and get them.

q.s: What did the boy forget?
q.en: What did the boy forget?

explain.zh: 手機和錢包都帶了，「忘了鑰匙」。
explain.en: He forgot his keys.

lines.s: Excuse me, I'm looking for Ms Patel's office. Is it the one next to the lift?
lines.zh: 不好意思，我在找帕特爾女士的辦公室，是電梯旁邊那間嗎？
lines.en: Excuse me, I'm looking for Ms Patel's office. Is it the one next to the lift?

lines.s: No, keep going — past the kitchen. Hers is the last door, right at the end of the corridor.
lines.zh: 不是，繼續往前走，經過茶水間，她的是最後一扇門，在走廊的盡頭。
lines.en: No, keep going — past the kitchen. Hers is the last door, right at the end of the corridor.

q.s: Where is Ms Patel's office?
q.zh: 帕特爾女士的辦公室在哪裡？
q.en: Where is Ms Patel's office?

options.t: at the end of the corridor

explain.zh: 不在電梯旁，要經過茶水間，「在走廊的盡頭」。
explain.en: The last door at the end of the corridor.

lines.s: Let's not have pizza again tonight. How about that new curry place?
lines.zh: 今晚別再吃披薩了。新開的咖哩店怎麼樣？
lines.en: Let's not have pizza again tonight. How about that new curry place?

lines.s: I had curry for lunch. What about fish?
lines.zh: 我中午吃咖哩了。吃魚好嗎？
lines.en: I had curry for lunch. What about fish?

lines.s: OK, fish it is.
lines.zh: 好，就吃魚。
lines.en: OK, fish it is.

q.s: What are they going to eat tonight?
q.en: What are they going to eat tonight?

explain.zh: 不吃披薩，男的中午吃過咖哩，最後「就吃魚」。
explain.en: Not pizza, not curry: fish.

lines.s: You will hear two friends talking about a film.
lines.zh: 你會聽到兩個朋友在談一部電影。
lines.en: You will hear two friends talking about a film.

lines.s: What did you think of the film?
lines.zh: 你覺得那部電影怎麼樣？
lines.en: What did you think of the film?

lines.s: The actors were great, but the story was hard to follow. I had no idea what was happening for the first hour.
lines.zh: 演員很棒，但故事很難懂。前一個小時我完全不知道在演什麼。
lines.en: The actors were great, but the story was hard to follow. I had no idea what was happening for the first hour.

ask.s: What did the woman think of the film?
ask.zh: 女的覺得那部電影怎麼樣？
ask.en: What did the woman think of the film?

explain.zh: 演員很棒，但「故事很難懂」。
explain.en: Great actors, but a confusing story.

lines.s: You will hear a man talking to a shop assistant.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位男士和店員說話。
lines.en: You will hear a man talking to a shop assistant.

lines.s: I bought these headphones last week, but the sound only comes out of one side.
lines.zh: 我上週買了這副耳機，可是只有一邊有聲音。
lines.en: I bought these headphones last week, but the sound only comes out of one side.

lines.s: I'm sorry. Would you like your money back, or another pair?
lines.zh: 很抱歉。您要退錢，還是換一副？
lines.en: I'm sorry. Would you like your money back, or another pair?

lines.s: Another pair, please. I really like them otherwise.
lines.zh: 換一副，謝謝。除此之外我很喜歡。
lines.en: Another pair, please. I really like them otherwise.

ask.s: What does the man want?
ask.en: What does the man want?

options.t: a new pair of the same headphones

explain.zh: 他要「換一副」，因為「除此之外我很喜歡」：同款的新耳機。
explain.en: Another pair of the same ones.

lines.s: You will hear a girl talking about a school trip.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一個女孩談學校的校外教學。
lines.en: You will hear a girl talking about a school trip.

lines.s: The museum was a bit boring, to be honest, but the boat trip afterwards was amazing. We saw dolphins! The only bad thing was the long coach journey home.
lines.zh: 說實話博物館有點無聊，但後來搭船超棒，我們看到了海豚！唯一不好的是回家的遊覽車坐很久。
lines.en: The museum was a bit boring, to be honest, but the boat trip afterwards was amazing. We saw dolphins! The only bad thing was the long coach journey home.

ask.s: What did the girl enjoy most?
ask.en: What did the girl enjoy most?

explain.zh: 博物館有點無聊、遊覽車坐很久，「搭船超棒」。
explain.en: The boat trip was amazing.

lines.s: You will hear a woman leaving a message for her friend.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位女士給朋友留言。
lines.en: You will hear a woman leaving a message for her friend.

lines.s: Hi Jo, it's Kate. I've got two tickets for the concert on Friday, but I can't go now — I've got to work late. Would you like them? You could take your sister.
lines.zh: 喬，我是凱特。我有兩張星期五演唱會的票，可是我現在不能去了，要加班。你要嗎？可以帶你妹妹去。
lines.en: Hi Jo, it's Kate. I've got two tickets for the concert on Friday, but I can't go now — I've got to work late. Would you like them? You could take your sister.

ask.s: Why is Kate calling?
ask.en: Why is Kate calling?

options.t: to invite Jo to a concert
to ask Jo to work late

explain.zh: 她不能去了，問「你要嗎？可以帶你妹妹去」：要把票給喬。
explain.en: She is offering her tickets.

lines.s: You will hear a man talking about his new flat.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位男士談他的新公寓。
lines.en: You will hear a man talking about his new flat.

lines.s: It's smaller than my old place, and the rent is about the same. But it's only five minutes from my office, so I don't have to drive any more.
lines.zh: 比我以前住的小，房租差不多。不過離公司只要五分鐘，所以我不用再開車了。
lines.en: It's smaller than my old place, and the rent is about the same. But it's only five minutes from my office, so I don't have to drive any more.

ask.s: What does the man like about his new flat?
ask.zh: 男的喜歡新公寓的什麼？
ask.en: What does the man like about his new flat?

options.t: It is close to his work.

explain.zh: 比較小、房租差不多，但「離公司只要五分鐘」。
explain.en: It is five minutes from his office.

lines.s: You will hear two friends talking about a sports centre.
lines.zh: 你會聽到兩個朋友談一家運動中心。
lines.en: You will hear two friends talking about a sports centre.

lines.s: Have you been to the new sports centre? The pool's lovely, but it's so expensive.
lines.zh: 你去過新的運動中心嗎？游泳池很棒，可是好貴。
lines.en: Have you been to the new sports centre? The pool's lovely, but it's so expensive.

lines.s: It is — but students get half price on weekdays, so I go on Wednesdays.
lines.zh: 是很貴，不過學生平日半價，所以我星期三去。
lines.en: It is — but students get half price on weekdays, so I go on Wednesdays.

ask.s: What does the man say about the sports centre?
ask.zh: 男的怎麼說這家運動中心？
ask.en: What does the man say about the sports centre?

options.t: It is cheaper for students on weekdays.

explain.zh: 「學生平日半價，所以我星期三去」。
explain.en: Half price for students on weekdays.

lines.s: Good morning, and welcome to this week's arts programme. This summer the Riverside Festival is back for its tenth year. It runs for three days, from the eighteenth to the twentieth of July, in Victoria Park. As always, there'll be music from local bands, but this year there's something new: a comedy tent, which will have shows every evening. Tickets cost twenty-five pounds for a day, or sixty for the whole weekend, and children under twelve go free. The organisers are asking people not to drive, because there's very little parking — instead, there'll be free buses from the railway station. If you'd like to help, they're still looking for volunteers, especially people who can work in the information tent. You can find out more on the festival website.
lines.zh: 早安，歡迎收聽本週的藝文節目。今年夏天，河畔音樂節迎來第十年。活動為期三天，七月十八日到二十日，在維多利亞公園舉行。和往年一樣有本地樂團的演出，不過今年有新東西：一個喜劇帳篷，每天晚上都有表演。單日票二十五英鎊，整個週末六十英鎊，十二歲以下兒童免費。主辦單位請大家不要開車，因為停車位很少；會有從火車站出發的免費接駁公車。想幫忙的話，他們還在招募志工，特別是能在服務帳篷工作的人。詳情請上音樂節網站。
lines.en: Good morning, and welcome to this week's arts programme. This summer the Riverside Festival is back for its tenth year. It runs for three days, from the eighteenth to the twentieth of July, in Victoria Park. As always, there'll be music from local bands, but this year there's something new: a comedy tent, which will have shows every evening. Tickets cost twenty-five pounds for a day, or sixty for the whole weekend, and children under twelve go free. The organisers are asking people not to drive, because there's very little parking — instead, there'll be free buses from the railway station. If you'd like to help, they're still looking for volunteers, especially people who can work in the information tent. You can find out more on the festival website.

ask.s: The festival is in ＿＿＿＿＿ Park.
ask.en: The festival is in ＿＿＿＿＿ Park.

explain.zh: 「在維多利亞公園舉行」。
explain.en: Victoria Park.

ask.s: New this year: a ＿＿＿＿＿ tent
ask.en: New this year: a ＿＿＿＿＿ tent

explain.zh: 「一個喜劇帳篷」。
explain.en: A comedy tent.

ask.s: A ticket for the whole weekend costs £＿＿＿＿＿.
ask.en: A ticket for the whole weekend costs £＿＿＿＿＿.

explain.zh: 單日二十五、「整個週末六十英鎊」。
explain.en: Sixty for the weekend; 25 is a day.

ask.s: Children under ＿＿＿＿＿ go free.
ask.en: Children under ＿＿＿＿＿ go free.

explain.zh: 「十二歲以下兒童免費」。
explain.en: Under twelve.

ask.s: Free buses leave from the ＿＿＿＿＿ station.
ask.en: Free buses leave from the ＿＿＿＿＿ station.

explain.zh: 「從火車站出發的免費接駁公車」。
explain.en: The railway station.

ask.s: Volunteers are needed in the ＿＿＿＿＿ tent.
ask.en: Volunteers are needed in the ＿＿＿＿＿ tent.

explain.zh: 「特別是能在服務帳篷工作的人」。
explain.en: The information tent.

lines.s: My guest today is Leo Grant, who at just twenty-three runs his own restaurant. Leo, when did you first get interested in cooking?
lines.zh: 今天的來賓是李歐·葛蘭特，他才二十三歲就經營自己的餐廳。李歐，你什麼時候開始對做菜有興趣的？
lines.en: My guest today is Leo Grant, who at just twenty-three runs his own restaurant. Leo, when did you first get interested in cooking?

lines.s: When I was about ten. My mum worked late, so I often made dinner for my younger brothers. At first it was just pasta, but I started experimenting.
lines.zh: 大概十歲的時候。我媽媽工作到很晚，所以我常幫弟弟們做晚餐。一開始只會煮義大利麵，後來開始嘗試各種做法。
lines.en: When I was about ten. My mum worked late, so I often made dinner for my younger brothers. At first it was just pasta, but I started experimenting.

lines.s: Did you go to cooking school?
lines.zh: 你讀過廚藝學校嗎？
lines.en: Did you go to cooking school?

lines.s: No. I started a business course at university, but I left after a year and got a job in a hotel kitchen. I learnt far more there than I would have in a classroom.
lines.zh: 沒有。我在大學讀過商科，但讀了一年就休學，到飯店廚房工作。我在那裡學到的比在教室裡多得多。
lines.en: No. I started a business course at university, but I left after a year and got a job in a hotel kitchen. I learnt far more there than I would have in a classroom.

lines.s: What's the hardest thing about running a restaurant?
lines.zh: 經營餐廳最難的是什麼？
lines.en: What's the hardest thing about running a restaurant?

lines.s: Finding good staff, definitely. The cooking is the easy part. And the hours are very long — I rarely get home before midnight.
lines.zh: 一定是找到好員工。做菜反而是簡單的部分。還有工時很長，我很少半夜前到家。
lines.en: Finding good staff, definitely. The cooking is the easy part. And the hours are very long — I rarely get home before midnight.

lines.s: What's next for you?
lines.zh: 你接下來有什麼計畫？
lines.en: What's next for you?

lines.s: I'd like to write a cookbook for young people who are learning to cook for themselves, like I did.
lines.zh: 我想寫一本食譜，給像我當年那樣、正在學自己做飯的年輕人。
lines.en: I'd like to write a cookbook for young people who are learning to cook for themselves, like I did.

ask.s: Why did Leo start cooking?
ask.en: Why did Leo start cooking?

options.t: He wanted to become a chef.
He had to make meals for his family.

explain.zh: 媽媽工作到很晚，「我常幫弟弟們做晚餐」。
explain.en: He cooked for his brothers because his mum worked late.

ask.s: What did Leo cook at first?
ask.en: What did Leo cook at first?

explain.zh: 「一開始只會煮義大利麵」。
explain.en: Just pasta at first.

ask.s: What did Leo study at university?
ask.en: What did Leo study at university?

explain.zh: 「我在大學讀過商科」，讀一年就休學了。
explain.en: A business course, which he left.

ask.s: Where did Leo learn most about cooking?
ask.zh: 李歐在哪裡學到最多做菜的事？
ask.en: Where did Leo learn most about cooking?

explain.zh: 在飯店廚房「學到的比在教室裡多得多」。
explain.en: In a hotel kitchen.

ask.s: What does Leo find most difficult?
ask.zh: 李歐覺得最難的是什麼？
ask.en: What does Leo find most difficult?

explain.zh: 「一定是找到好員工。做菜反而是簡單的部分」。
explain.en: Finding good staff; cooking is easy.

ask.s: What does Leo want to do next?
ask.en: What does Leo want to do next?

explain.zh: 「我想寫一本食譜」，給正在學做飯的年輕人。
explain.en: Write a cookbook for young people.

lines.s: How are you getting to Edinburgh? By coach?
lines.zh: 你要怎麼去愛丁堡？搭長途巴士嗎？
lines.en: How are you getting to Edinburgh? By coach?

lines.s: The coach takes nine hours, and the train's really expensive this month, so I'm flying. It's actually cheaper.
lines.zh: 巴士要九個小時，火車這個月又超貴，所以我搭飛機。其實還比較便宜。
lines.en: The coach takes nine hours, and the train's really expensive this month, so I'm flying. It's actually cheaper.

q.s: How will the man travel to Edinburgh?
q.en: How will the man travel to Edinburgh?

explain.zh: 巴士太久、火車太貴，「所以我搭飛機」。
explain.en: The coach is slow and the train expensive, so he is flying.

lines.s: What did you get your mum for her birthday? Flowers again?
lines.zh: 你送媽媽什麼生日禮物？又是花嗎？
lines.en: What did you get your mum for her birthday? Flowers again?

lines.s: No, she says she's got nowhere to put them. I was going to get chocolates, but she's trying to eat healthily, so I made her a card myself.
lines.zh: 不是，她說花沒地方放。我本來要買巧克力，可是她在努力吃健康一點，所以我自己做了一張卡片。
lines.en: No, she says she's got nowhere to put them. I was going to get chocolates, but she's trying to eat healthily, so I made her a card myself.

q.s: What did the girl give her mother?
q.en: What did the girl give her mother?

explain.zh: 花沒地方放、巧克力不健康，「我自己做了一張卡片」。
explain.en: Not flowers or chocolates: a card she made.

lines.s: Have you packed everything for the beach?
lines.zh: 去海邊的東西都打包好了嗎？
lines.en: Have you packed everything for the beach?

lines.s: I've got my sunglasses and the sun cream. Oh no — I can't find my hat anywhere.
lines.zh: 太陽眼鏡和防曬乳都帶了。糟了，我的帽子到處都找不到。
lines.en: I've got my sunglasses and the sun cream. Oh no — I can't find my hat anywhere.

lines.s: You can borrow mine.
lines.zh: 你可以借我的。
lines.en: You can borrow mine.

q.s: What will the man borrow?
q.en: What will the man borrow?

explain.zh: 太陽眼鏡和防曬乳都有，「帽子找不到」，女的借他她的。
explain.en: He can't find his hat, so he borrows hers.

lines.s: Did you buy a desk for your new room?
lines.zh: 你有為新房間買書桌嗎？
lines.en: Did you buy a desk for your new room?

lines.s: I was going to, but there's already one built into the wall. I got a bookshelf instead — I've got so many books. The sofa I wanted was too big.
lines.zh: 本來要買，可是牆上已經有一張內建的了。我改買了書架，我的書太多了。我想要的沙發太大了。
lines.en: I was going to, but there's already one built into the wall. I got a bookshelf instead — I've got so many books. The sofa I wanted was too big.

q.s: What did the woman buy?
q.en: What did the woman buy?

explain.zh: 書桌房間裡已經有、沙發太大，「我改買了書架」。
explain.en: There is a desk already and the sofa was too big: a bookshelf.

lines.s: Are you still going running every morning?
lines.zh: 你還每天早上去跑步嗎？
lines.en: Are you still going running every morning?

lines.s: My knee started hurting, so the doctor told me to stop for a while. I've taken up cycling instead — swimming's too boring for me.
lines.zh: 我膝蓋開始痛，醫生叫我先停一陣子。我改騎腳踏車，游泳對我來說太無聊了。
lines.en: My knee started hurting, so the doctor told me to stop for a while. I've taken up cycling instead — swimming's too boring for me.

q.s: What exercise does the man do now?
q.en: What exercise does the man do now?

explain.zh: 醫生叫他停止跑步，游泳太無聊，「我改騎腳踏車」。
explain.en: No running, swimming is boring: cycling.

lines.s: Where's the end-of-year concert? On the sports field?
lines.zh: 期末音樂會在哪裡辦？運動場嗎？
lines.en: Where's the end-of-year concert? On the sports field?

lines.s: That was the plan, but it's going to rain, so they've moved it to the school hall. Not a classroom — they're too small.
lines.zh: 本來是，可是會下雨，所以改到學校禮堂。不是教室，教室太小了。
lines.en: That was the plan, but it's going to rain, so they've moved it to the school hall. Not a classroom — they're too small.

q.s: Where will the concert be?
q.en: Where will the concert be?

explain.zh: 會下雨，「改到學校禮堂」；教室太小。
explain.en: Moved to the school hall because of rain.

lines.s: What happened to Tom? Did he break his arm playing football?
lines.zh: 湯姆怎麼了？踢足球摔斷手嗎？
lines.en: What happened to Tom? Did he break his arm playing football?

lines.s: No, that was last year. He's at the dentist — he's had terrible toothache all week.
lines.zh: 不是，那是去年的事。他在看牙醫，這整個星期牙痛得要命。
lines.en: No, that was last year. He's at the dentist — he's had terrible toothache all week.

q.s: What is wrong with Tom now?
q.en: What is wrong with Tom now?

explain.zh: 斷手是去年，現在「牙痛得要命」。
explain.en: The arm was last year; now toothache.

lines.s: You will hear two friends talking about a café.
lines.zh: 你會聽到兩個朋友談一家咖啡館。
lines.en: You will hear two friends talking about a café.

lines.s: The cakes there are amazing, but you have to wait ages to be served.
lines.zh: 那裡的蛋糕超好吃，可是要等好久才有人來點餐。
lines.en: The cakes there are amazing, but you have to wait ages to be served.

lines.s: That's true. I still go there every week, though — it's so near my flat.
lines.zh: 沒錯。不過我還是每週都去，因為離我住的公寓好近。
lines.en: That's true. I still go there every week, though — it's so near my flat.

ask.s: Why does the man go to the café?
ask.zh: 男的為什麼去那家咖啡館？
ask.en: Why does the man go to the café?

options.t: It is close to where he lives.

explain.zh: 「離我住的公寓好近」；服務其實很慢。
explain.en: It is near his flat; the service is slow.

lines.s: You will hear a woman phoning a hotel.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位女士打電話給飯店。
lines.en: You will hear a woman phoning a hotel.

lines.s: Hello, I booked a room for Friday and Saturday. I'm afraid I can only arrive on Saturday now. Could you change my booking, please?
lines.zh: 您好，我訂了星期五和星期六的房間。恐怕我現在只能星期六到。可以幫我改訂房嗎？
lines.en: Hello, I booked a room for Friday and Saturday. I'm afraid I can only arrive on Saturday now. Could you change my booking, please?

ask.s: What does the woman want to do?
ask.en: What does the woman want to do?

options.t: stay for one night instead of two

explain.zh: 原本訂兩晚，現在「只能星期六到」：改成只住一晚。
explain.en: Two nights become one.

lines.s: You will hear a teacher talking to a student.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位老師和學生說話。
lines.en: You will hear a teacher talking to a student.

lines.s: Your essay has some excellent ideas, Ellie, but it is twice as long as it should be. Next time, try to keep to the word limit.
lines.zh: 艾莉，你的作文有些很棒的想法，可是長度是規定的兩倍。下次請遵守字數限制。
lines.en: Your essay has some excellent ideas, Ellie, but it is twice as long as it should be. Next time, try to keep to the word limit.

ask.s: What does the teacher say about the essay?
ask.en: What does the teacher say about the essay?

explain.zh: 想法很棒，但「長度是規定的兩倍」。
explain.en: Excellent ideas, but twice too long.

lines.s: You will hear two friends talking about a holiday.
lines.zh: 你會聽到兩個朋友談一次假期。
lines.en: You will hear two friends talking about a holiday.

lines.s: How was your camping trip?
lines.zh: 你的露營之旅怎麼樣？
lines.en: How was your camping trip?

lines.s: The campsite was beautiful, right next to a lake. But it rained every single day, so we came home early.
lines.zh: 營地很漂亮，就在湖邊。可是每天都下雨，所以我們提早回家了。
lines.en: The campsite was beautiful, right next to a lake. But it rained every single day, so we came home early.

ask.s: What was the problem with the trip?
ask.en: What was the problem with the trip?

explain.zh: 營地和湖都很好，「每天都下雨」。
explain.en: The campsite was lovely; it rained every day.

lines.s: You will hear a man talking about learning Spanish.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位男士談學西班牙文。
lines.en: You will hear a man talking about learning Spanish.

lines.s: I've tried apps and evening classes, but what really helped was watching Spanish TV series with subtitles. Now I understand much more.
lines.zh: 我試過 App 和夜間課程，但真正有幫助的是看有字幕的西班牙影集。現在我聽懂的多了很多。
lines.en: I've tried apps and evening classes, but what really helped was watching Spanish TV series with subtitles. Now I understand much more.

ask.s: What helped the man most?
ask.en: What helped the man most?

explain.zh: 「真正有幫助的是看有字幕的西班牙影集」。
explain.en: Watching Spanish TV series with subtitles.

lines.s: You will hear two colleagues talking about a meeting.
lines.zh: 你會聽到兩位同事談一場會議。
lines.en: You will hear two colleagues talking about a meeting.

lines.s: Is the meeting still at two?
lines.zh: 會議還是兩點嗎？
lines.en: Is the meeting still at two?

lines.s: It's been moved to three, because the manager's train is delayed. Same room, though.
lines.zh: 改到三點了，因為經理的火車誤點。會議室不變。
lines.en: It's been moved to three, because the manager's train is delayed. Same room, though.

ask.s: Why has the meeting changed?
ask.en: Why has the meeting changed?

options.t: Someone is going to be late.

explain.zh: 「經理的火車誤點」：有人會遲到。
explain.en: The manager's train is delayed.

lines.s: Hi, everyone. I'm Dr Rachel Moore from Northfield University, and I'm here to tell you about our Young Scientists Week. It takes place in the first week of August, from Monday to Friday, and it's for students aged fourteen to seventeen. Every morning there are talks from university researchers, and in the afternoons you'll work in our labs. This year's topic is the ocean, so on Thursday we're taking everyone on a boat trip to collect water samples. The course costs a hundred and twenty pounds, but if your family can't afford that, we have some free places. You'll stay in student rooms on the campus, and all meals are included. On the last day, each group gives a presentation to their parents. To apply, just fill in the form on our website before the thirtieth of June.
lines.zh: 大家好，我是北原大學的瑞秋·摩爾博士，來介紹我們的「小小科學家週」。活動在八月第一週，星期一到星期五，給十四到十七歲的學生參加。每天早上有大學研究人員的演講，下午在我們的實驗室做實驗。今年的主題是海洋，所以星期四會帶大家搭船出海採集海水樣本。課程費用一百二十英鎊，如果家裡負擔不起，我們也有一些免費名額。大家住在校園裡的學生宿舍，三餐全包。最後一天，每組要向家長做一場簡報。報名請在六月三十日前填寫我們網站上的表格。
lines.en: Hi, everyone. I'm Dr Rachel Moore from Northfield University, and I'm here to tell you about our Young Scientists Week. It takes place in the first week of August, from Monday to Friday, and it's for students aged fourteen to seventeen. Every morning there are talks from university researchers, and in the afternoons you'll work in our labs. This year's topic is the ocean, so on Thursday we're taking everyone on a boat trip to collect water samples. The course costs a hundred and twenty pounds, but if your family can't afford that, we have some free places. You'll stay in student rooms on the campus, and all meals are included. On the last day, each group gives a presentation to their parents. To apply, just fill in the form on our website before the thirtieth of June.

ask.s: For students aged 14 to ＿＿＿＿＿
ask.en: For students aged 14 to ＿＿＿＿＿

explain.zh: 「十四到十七歲的學生」。
explain.en: Aged fourteen to seventeen.

ask.s: This year's topic: the ＿＿＿＿＿
ask.en: This year's topic: the ＿＿＿＿＿

explain.zh: 「今年的主題是海洋」。
explain.en: The ocean.

ask.s: On Thursday: a ＿＿＿＿＿ trip
ask.en: On Thursday: a ＿＿＿＿＿ trip

explain.zh: 「星期四會帶大家搭船出海」。
explain.en: A boat trip on Thursday.

explain.zh: 「課程費用一百二十英鎊」。
explain.en: A hundred and twenty pounds.

ask.s: On the last day: a ＿＿＿＿＿ to parents
ask.en: On the last day: a ＿＿＿＿＿ to parents

explain.zh: 「每組要向家長做一場簡報」。
explain.en: A presentation to their parents.

ask.s: Apply before ＿＿＿＿＿ June
ask.en: Apply before ＿＿＿＿＿ June

explain.zh: 「六月三十日前」。
explain.en: Before the thirtieth of June.

lines.s: My guest today is Sam Ellis, a wildlife photographer whose pictures of foxes in the city have become famous online. Sam, how did you start?
lines.zh: 今天的來賓是野生動物攝影師山姆·艾利斯，他拍城市狐狸的照片在網路上很紅。山姆，你是怎麼開始的？
lines.en: My guest today is Sam Ellis, a wildlife photographer whose pictures of foxes in the city have become famous online. Sam, how did you start?

lines.s: I got my first camera when I was fifteen — it was my grandad's old one. I started by photographing birds in our garden, because I couldn't go far.
lines.zh: 我十五歲拿到第一台相機，是爺爺的舊相機。我先拍我家院子裡的鳥，因為我沒辦法跑太遠。
lines.en: I got my first camera when I was fifteen — it was my grandad's old one. I started by photographing birds in our garden, because I couldn't go far.

lines.s: Why foxes?
lines.zh: 為什麼拍狐狸？
lines.en: Why foxes?

lines.s: One night I saw a fox sitting at a bus stop near my flat, completely relaxed. I thought: people don't realise how many wild animals live right next to them in the city.
lines.zh: 有一天晚上，我看到一隻狐狸坐在我家附近的公車站，完全很放鬆。我心想：大家都沒發現城市裡有多少野生動物就住在身邊。
lines.en: One night I saw a fox sitting at a bus stop near my flat, completely relaxed. I thought: people don't realise how many wild animals live right next to them in the city.

lines.s: Is it difficult to photograph them?
lines.zh: 拍牠們很難嗎？
lines.en: Is it difficult to photograph them?

lines.s: Very. They're active at night, so the light is poor. I often wait for hours and get nothing. Patience is more important than an expensive camera.
lines.zh: 很難。牠們晚上才活動，光線很差。我常常等好幾個小時什麼都拍不到。耐心比貴的相機重要。
lines.en: Very. They're active at night, so the light is poor. I often wait for hours and get nothing. Patience is more important than an expensive camera.

lines.s: Your photos got a lot of attention last year.
lines.zh: 你的照片去年受到很多關注。
lines.en: Your photos got a lot of attention last year.

lines.s: Yes — one was chosen for a national competition. Since then, I've been asked to give talks in schools, which I love.
lines.zh: 對，有一張入選全國比賽。從那之後，常有學校請我去演講，我很喜歡。
lines.en: Yes — one was chosen for a national competition. Since then, I've been asked to give talks in schools, which I love.

lines.s: What's next?
lines.zh: 接下來呢？
lines.en: What's next?

lines.s: I'm working on a book about wildlife in cities, with photos from ten different countries. I'm off to Tokyo next month.
lines.zh: 我在做一本關於城市野生動物的書，有十個國家的照片。下個月我要去東京。
lines.en: I'm working on a book about wildlife in cities, with photos from ten different countries. I'm off to Tokyo next month.

ask.s: What did Sam first take photos of?
ask.en: What did Sam first take photos of?

explain.zh: 「我先拍我家院子裡的鳥」。
explain.en: Birds in the garden.

ask.s: Where did Sam get his first camera?
ask.zh: 山姆的第一台相機是從哪來的？
ask.en: Where did Sam get his first camera?

explain.zh: 「是爺爺的舊相機」。
explain.en: It was his grandad's old one.

ask.s: What made Sam interested in foxes?
ask.zh: 是什麼讓山姆對狐狸有興趣？
ask.en: What made Sam interested in foxes?

explain.zh: 晚上看到一隻狐狸坐在公車站。
explain.en: Seeing a fox at a bus stop.

ask.s: What does Sam say is most important for his work?
ask.zh: 山姆說他的工作最重要的是什麼？
ask.en: What does Sam say is most important for his work?

explain.zh: 「耐心比貴的相機重要」。
explain.en: Patience matters more than an expensive camera.

ask.s: What has happened since the competition?
ask.en: What has happened since the competition?

explain.zh: 「常有學校請我去演講」。
explain.en: He gives talks in schools.

ask.s: What is Sam doing next month?
ask.en: What is Sam doing next month?

explain.zh: 「下個月我要去東京」。
explain.en: Going to Tokyo.

lines.s: What are you having for lunch?
lines.zh: 你午餐要吃什麼？
lines.en: What are you having for lunch?

lines.s: I'd love some pasta, but it takes too long, and the soup's finished. I'll just have a cheese sandwich.
lines.zh: 我很想吃義大利麵，可是要煮太久，湯也賣完了。我就吃個起司三明治吧。
lines.en: I'd love some pasta, but it takes too long, and the soup's finished. I'll just have a cheese sandwich.

q.s: What will the woman have for lunch?
q.en: What will the woman have for lunch?

explain.zh: 義大利麵太久、湯賣完，「就吃個起司三明治」。
explain.en: Pasta takes too long, no soup: a sandwich.

lines.s: Is your sister still learning the guitar?
lines.zh: 你妹妹還在學吉他嗎？
lines.en: Is your sister still learning the guitar?

lines.s: She gave up — her fingers hurt too much. Now she sings in a band. She wanted to play the drums, but our neighbours would complain.
lines.zh: 她放棄了，手指太痛。現在她在一個樂團唱歌。她想打鼓，可是鄰居會抱怨。
lines.en: She gave up — her fingers hurt too much. Now she sings in a band. She wanted to play the drums, but our neighbours would complain.

q.s: What does the sister do in the band?
q.en: What does the sister do in the band?

explain.zh: 吉他放棄了、鼓不能打，「現在她在一個樂團唱歌」。
explain.en: She sings; no guitar, no drums.

lines.s: What are you taking on holiday? Your surfboard?
lines.zh: 你度假要帶什麼？衝浪板嗎？
lines.en: What are you taking on holiday? Your surfboard?

lines.s: No, we're going to the mountains. There's loads of snow this year, so I'm taking my skis. I'll leave my bike at home.
lines.zh: 不是，我們要去山上。今年雪很多，所以我帶滑雪板。腳踏車就留在家。
lines.en: No, we're going to the mountains. There's loads of snow this year, so I'm taking my skis. I'll leave my bike at home.

q.s: What is the woman taking on holiday?
q.en: What is the woman taking on holiday?

explain.zh: 去山上、雪很多，「所以我帶滑雪板」。
explain.en: Lots of snow in the mountains: skis.

lines.s: Did you cycle to work today?
lines.zh: 你今天騎腳踏車上班嗎？
lines.en: Did you cycle to work today?

lines.s: No, my bike's got a flat tyre, and my scooter's at my brother's. So I drove — and sat in traffic for an hour!
lines.zh: 沒有，我的腳踏車爆胎了，機車又在我哥那裡。所以我開車，結果塞了一個小時！
lines.en: No, my bike's got a flat tyre, and my scooter's at my brother's. So I drove — and sat in traffic for an hour!

q.s: How did the man get to work today?
q.en: How did the man get to work today?

explain.zh: 腳踏車爆胎、機車不在，「所以我開車」。
explain.en: Flat tyre, no scooter: he drove.

lines.s: Where's the cat? She's not on the bed.
lines.zh: 貓呢？她不在床上。
lines.en: Where's the cat? She's not on the bed.

lines.s: She's not under the table either. Oh look — she's on the windowsill, watching the birds.
lines.zh: 也不在桌子底下。啊，你看，她在窗台上看鳥。
lines.en: She's not under the table either. Oh look — she's on the windowsill, watching the birds.

q.s: Where is the cat?
q.en: Where is the cat?

explain.zh: 不在床上、不在桌下，「她在窗台上看鳥」。
explain.en: On the windowsill, watching birds.

lines.s: Did you get a new laptop for university?
lines.zh: 你為了上大學買新筆電了嗎？
lines.en: Did you get a new laptop for university?

lines.s: I was going to, but they're so expensive. I've bought a tablet with a keyboard — it's lighter, too. My phone's too small for writing essays.
lines.zh: 本來要買，可是筆電好貴。我買了一台附鍵盤的平板，也比較輕。手機太小，不能寫報告。
lines.en: I was going to, but they're so expensive. I've bought a tablet with a keyboard — it's lighter, too. My phone's too small for writing essays.

q.s: What did the man buy?
q.en: What did the man buy?

explain.zh: 筆電太貴，「我買了一台附鍵盤的平板」。
explain.en: Laptops are expensive: a tablet with a keyboard.

lines.s: What did your dad do at the weekend?
lines.zh: 你爸爸週末做了什麼？
lines.en: What did your dad do at the weekend?

lines.s: Mum asked him to cut the grass, but it rained all weekend, so he stayed in and painted the kitchen. The car still needs fixing!
lines.zh: 媽媽要他割草，可是整個週末都在下雨，所以他待在家裡油漆廚房。車子還是需要修！
lines.en: Mum asked him to cut the grass, but it rained all weekend, so he stayed in and painted the kitchen. The car still needs fixing!

q.s: What did the father do at the weekend?
q.en: What did the father do at the weekend?

explain.zh: 下雨不能割草，「他待在家裡油漆廚房」；車還沒修。
explain.en: Rain stopped the grass; he painted the kitchen.

lines.s: You will hear a boy talking about a football match.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一個男孩談一場足球賽。
lines.en: You will hear a boy talking about a football match.

lines.s: We lost three-nil, but honestly, the other team were just better than us. Our coach said we played well, and I agree.
lines.zh: 我們零比三輸了，不過老實說，對方就是比我們強。教練說我們踢得不錯，我也同意。
lines.en: We lost three-nil, but honestly, the other team were just better than us. Our coach said we played well, and I agree.

ask.s: How does the boy feel about the match?
ask.zh: 男孩對這場比賽有什麼看法？
ask.en: How does the boy feel about the match?

options.t: He is angry with the referee.
He is disappointed with his team.
He thinks the other team deserved to win.

explain.zh: 「對方就是比我們強」，也同意自己踢得不錯。
explain.en: The other team were better; his team played well.

lines.s: You will hear two friends talking about a new phone.
lines.zh: 你會聽到兩個朋友談一支新手機。
lines.en: You will hear two friends talking about a new phone.

lines.s: Is your new phone any good?
lines.zh: 你的新手機好用嗎？
lines.en: Is your new phone any good?

lines.s: The camera's brilliant, but the battery doesn't last long. I have to charge it twice a day.
lines.zh: 相機超棒，可是電池撐不久，我一天要充兩次電。
lines.en: The camera's brilliant, but the battery doesn't last long. I have to charge it twice a day.

ask.s: What does the man complain about?
ask.en: What does the man complain about?

explain.zh: 相機超棒，「電池撐不久」。
explain.en: The battery; the camera is brilliant.

lines.s: You will hear a woman at a train station.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位女士在火車站。
lines.en: You will hear a woman at a train station.

lines.s: Excuse me, is this the train to Oxford?
lines.zh: 不好意思，這是去牛津的火車嗎？
lines.en: Excuse me, is this the train to Oxford?

lines.s: It goes to Oxford, but it stops at every station, so it is very slow. The fast train leaves in ten minutes from platform three.
lines.zh: 是會到牛津，可是每站都停，很慢。快車十分鐘後從第三月台發車。
lines.en: It goes to Oxford, but it stops at every station, so it is very slow. The fast train leaves in ten minutes from platform three.

ask.s: What does the man suggest?
ask.en: What does the man suggest?

explain.zh: 這班每站都停，快車十分鐘後開：建議等另一班。
explain.en: Wait ten minutes for the fast train.

lines.s: You will hear a girl talking about volunteering.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一個女孩談當志工。
lines.en: You will hear a girl talking about volunteering.

lines.s: I help at the animal shelter every Saturday. The dogs need walking and the cages need cleaning, but my favourite job is feeding the cats.
lines.zh: 我每個星期六在動物收容所幫忙。狗要遛，籠子要清，不過我最喜歡的工作是餵貓。
lines.en: I help at the animal shelter every Saturday. The dogs need walking and the cages need cleaning, but my favourite job is feeding the cats.

ask.s: What does the girl enjoy most?
ask.en: What does the girl enjoy most?

explain.zh: 「我最喜歡的工作是餵貓」。
explain.en: Feeding the cats.

lines.s: You will hear a man talking to his neighbour.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位男士和鄰居說話。
lines.en: You will hear a man talking to his neighbour.

lines.s: Could you look after my plants while I'm away next week? Just water them every two days. I'll leave the key under the mat.
lines.zh: 我下週不在，可以幫我照顧植物嗎？每兩天澆一次水就好。我會把鑰匙放在腳踏墊底下。
lines.en: Could you look after my plants while I'm away next week? Just water them every two days. I'll leave the key under the mat.

ask.s: What does the man ask the neighbour to do?
ask.en: What does the man ask the neighbour to do?

explain.zh: 「幫我照顧植物」，每兩天澆水。
explain.en: Water his plants.

lines.s: You will hear two students talking about an exam.
lines.zh: 你會聽到兩個學生談一場考試。
lines.en: You will hear two students talking about an exam.

lines.s: How did the maths exam go?
lines.zh: 數學考得怎麼樣？
lines.en: How did the maths exam go?

lines.s: Better than I expected. I didn't finish the last question, but I think I got everything else right.
lines.zh: 比我預期的好。最後一題沒寫完，不過其他的我應該都對了。
lines.en: Better than I expected. I didn't finish the last question, but I think I got everything else right.

ask.s: How does the boy feel about the exam?
ask.zh: 男孩覺得考試考得如何？
ask.en: How does the boy feel about the exam?

explain.zh: 「比我預期的好」，其他題應該都對。
explain.en: Better than he expected.

lines.s: And now some local news. From next Monday, the city's new bike-hire scheme opens to the public. There will be three hundred bikes at forty stations around the city centre. To use the bikes, you'll first need to download the City Bikes app. The first thirty minutes of every ride are free, and after that it costs one pound for each hour. The bikes are electric, so they're easy to ride up the hills on the north side of the city. Riders must be at least sixteen years old. Helmets aren't provided, so please bring your own. The council hopes the scheme will reduce traffic, and if it's popular, more stations will open next spring.
lines.zh: 接下來是地方新聞。從下週一開始，市區新的租借單車計畫開放民眾使用。市中心四十個站點共有三百輛單車。要使用單車，得先下載「城市單車」App。每次騎乘前三十分鐘免費，之後每小時一英鎊。單車是電動的，騎上城北的山坡也很輕鬆。騎乘者至少要十六歲。不提供安全帽，請自備。市議會希望這個計畫能減少車流，如果受歡迎，明年春天會再開更多站點。
lines.en: And now some local news. From next Monday, the city's new bike-hire scheme opens to the public. There will be three hundred bikes at forty stations around the city centre. To use the bikes, you'll first need to download the City Bikes app. The first thirty minutes of every ride are free, and after that it costs one pound for each hour. The bikes are electric, so they're easy to ride up the hills on the north side of the city. Riders must be at least sixteen years old. Helmets aren't provided, so please bring your own. The council hopes the scheme will reduce traffic, and if it's popular, more stations will open next spring.

ask.s: Number of bikes: ＿＿＿＿＿
ask.en: Number of bikes: ＿＿＿＿＿

explain.zh: 「共有三百輛單車」；四十是站點數。
explain.en: 300 bikes; 40 is the stations.

ask.s: First download the City Bikes ＿＿＿＿＿
ask.en: First download the City Bikes ＿＿＿＿＿

explain.zh: 「得先下載城市單車 App」。
explain.en: The City Bikes app.

ask.s: The first ＿＿＿＿＿ minutes are free.
ask.en: The first ＿＿＿＿＿ minutes are free.

explain.zh: 「前三十分鐘免費」。
explain.en: Thirty minutes.

ask.s: After that: £1 for each ＿＿＿＿＿
ask.en: After that: £1 for each ＿＿＿＿＿

explain.zh: 「之後每小時一英鎊」。
explain.en: One pound an hour.

ask.s: Riders must be at least ＿＿＿＿＿.
ask.en: Riders must be at least ＿＿＿＿＿.

explain.zh: 「至少要十六歲」。
explain.en: Sixteen.

ask.s: More stations may open next ＿＿＿＿＿.
ask.en: More stations may open next ＿＿＿＿＿.

explain.zh: 「明年春天會再開更多站點」。
explain.en: Next spring.

lines.s: Today I'm talking to Nina Shah, who started a repair café in her town two years ago. Nina, what exactly is a repair café?
lines.zh: 今天我要訪問妮娜·夏，她兩年前在她住的小鎮開了一間「修理咖啡館」。妮娜，修理咖啡館到底是什麼？
lines.en: Today I'm talking to Nina Shah, who started a repair café in her town two years ago. Nina, what exactly is a repair café?

lines.s: It's a free event where people bring broken things — lamps, toasters, clothes, bikes — and volunteers help them fix them. The idea is that you learn to repair things yourself, not just watch.
lines.zh: 是一個免費的活動，大家帶壞掉的東西來，像檯燈、烤麵包機、衣服、腳踏車，志工幫他們修。重點是你自己學會修，不是只在旁邊看。
lines.en: It's a free event where people bring broken things — lamps, toasters, clothes, bikes — and volunteers help them fix them. The idea is that you learn to repair things yourself, not just watch.

lines.s: How did it start?
lines.zh: 是怎麼開始的？
lines.en: How did it start?

lines.s: My laptop broke while I was at university, and the shop said it would be cheaper to buy a new one. My uncle, who's an engineer, fixed it in twenty minutes. I thought: how many things do we throw away that only need a small repair?
lines.zh: 我讀大學時筆電壞了，店家說買新的還比較便宜。我舅舅是工程師，二十分鐘就修好了。我心想：我們丟掉了多少只要小修一下的東西？
lines.en: My laptop broke while I was at university, and the shop said it would be cheaper to buy a new one. My uncle, who's an engineer, fixed it in twenty minutes. I thought: how many things do we throw away that only need a small repair?

lines.s: Who are the volunteers?
lines.zh: 志工是哪些人？
lines.en: Who are the volunteers?

lines.s: Mostly retired people with practical skills — a former electrician, a tailor, a bike mechanic. They love sharing what they know.
lines.zh: 大多是有實用技能的退休人士，像以前的電工、裁縫、腳踏車技師。他們很喜歡分享所學。
lines.en: Mostly retired people with practical skills — a former electrician, a tailor, a bike mechanic. They love sharing what they know.

lines.s: What's the most unusual thing anyone has brought?
lines.zh: 有人帶來過最特別的東西是什麼？
lines.en: What's the most unusual thing anyone has brought?

lines.s: A hundred-year-old clock that belonged to a man's great-grandmother. It took three months, but it works again now.
lines.zh: 一個一百年的老時鐘，是一位男士曾祖母的。花了三個月，不過現在又能走了。
lines.en: A hundred-year-old clock that belonged to a man's great-grandmother. It took three months, but it works again now.

lines.s: What's your plan for the future?
lines.zh: 你未來有什麼計畫？
lines.en: What's your plan for the future?

lines.s: At the moment we meet once a month in the town hall. I'd like to have a permanent workshop that's open every weekend.
lines.zh: 目前我們每個月在鎮公所聚一次。我希望有一間固定的工作坊，每個週末都開。
lines.en: At the moment we meet once a month in the town hall. I'd like to have a permanent workshop that's open every weekend.

ask.s: What happens at a repair café?
ask.en: What happens at a repair café?

options.t: Volunteers fix things while people wait.
People learn to fix their own things.

explain.zh: 「重點是你自己學會修，不是只在旁邊看」。
explain.en: You learn to repair things yourself.

ask.s: Why did Nina start the repair café?
ask.zh: 妮娜為什麼開修理咖啡館？
ask.en: Why did Nina start the repair café?

options.t: She realised many things are thrown away unnecessarily.

explain.zh: 筆電二十分鐘就修好，她想到「我們丟掉了多少只要小修一下的東西」。
explain.en: Many things that need only a small repair are thrown away.

ask.s: Who are most of the volunteers?
ask.en: Who are most of the volunteers?

explain.zh: 「大多是有實用技能的退休人士」。
explain.en: Mostly retired people.

ask.s: What was special about the clock?
ask.en: What was special about the clock?

options.t: It was fixed in twenty minutes.

explain.zh: 「一百年的老時鐘」；二十分鐘是修筆電。
explain.en: A hundred years old; twenty minutes was the laptop.

ask.s: How often is the repair café held now?
ask.zh: 修理咖啡館現在多久辦一次？
ask.en: How often is the repair café held now?

explain.zh: 「目前我們每個月聚一次」；每個週末是她的目標。
explain.en: Once a month; every weekend is the plan.

ask.s: What does Nina want in the future?
ask.en: What does Nina want in the future?

explain.zh: 「希望有一間固定的工作坊」。
explain.en: A permanent workshop.
